lines.en: Oh, hey, Monica, we got a question.
All right, for the zillionth time,
yes, I see other women in the shower at the gym,
We're trying to figure out who to bring to the Knicks game tonight.
Yeah, Ross can't go, so it's between my friend Eric Prower,
Do you want some more beer?
Hey, why don't you ask Richard?
if you had an extra ticket to the Knicks game
and you had to choose between
a friend who smelled and one who bruises you,
Well, being a huge Knicks fan myself,
I think you should take someone who's a huge Knicks fan.
